Imbued with excess and pain, the imagination of the dark mechanics forged the Sirenbow class Stalker.
Walking guns, they stalk across the battlefield picking off targets before they know it.

This kit includes everything you need to build a Sirenbow Stalkers in 8mm or AT scale.
The main body measures about the height of the standard Stalker.
This can be built in any number of ways, the kit is flexible with the legs and body being posable.

The kit includes, amongst standard components:
- 2 different feet
- 3 tail weapon options

Four files include:
1. Supported: individual components to print and pose as you desire.
2. Unsupported: as above but supported.
3. Complete: some example builds which you can use as an example or print as a single object. Supported versions included.

The model has been made to go on a 50mm bases and this has been included.


All files come supported and unsupported.

Pictures of models are test prints.
Pictured in the background are the [Rapture Heavy Stalkers](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/rapture-heavy-stalkers-8mm)

The Excess God: Demon Chariots 5.0 bundle delivers a brutal and decadent vision of war at 10mm scale, featuring three distinct demon chariot models forged to embody speed, excess, and merciless destruction on the battlefield. Each chariot is designed with aggressive silhouettes, dynamic motion, and exaggerated details that remain crisp and readable even at small scale, making them ideal centerpieces for dark fantasy or infernal-themed armies.

Every model in this bundle is carefully optimized for high-quality resin printing. All miniatures come manually pre-supported using Lychee Slicer, with supports placed by hand to ensure reliable prints, minimal cleanup, and maximum preservation of fine details. The geometry is engineered to reduce unnecessary islands while maintaining structural strength, allowing for efficient and consistent printing across multiple copies.

These miniatures are created for miniature-agnostic tabletop games, giving players full freedom to use them across a wide range of custom systems and settings.
